title: Close W5-12 by wiring real reviewed-document export data and line-item flow for enable_stock=true companies
fallback_model: Claude Sonnet only if the implementation stays tightly scoped and still closes the full acceptance below
objective: Implement the real W5-12 production path that is still open after SIT proof: export must use real reviewed/mapped documents instead of demo or caller-supplied sample rows, and companies with enable_stock=true must run a non-blocking line-item extraction path that persists rows, exposes them for human confirmation, and includes confirmed line rows in export output.
current_truth_from_live_sit: W5-02 Processing UX is live and honest on SIT.
W5-03 user fixes are mostly live-proven.
W5-04 Mapping Rules DOCX row delete is live-proven; COA Thai glyph repair is still separate and open.
W5-06 blank Template Configurator path is live-proven, but full export continuity is still open.

W5-12 is NOT closed: live SIT still shows only the honest line-item notice for enable_stock=true companies; summary.json records real_line_item_rows_confirmed=false and real_line_item_export_confirmed=false.

Current export endpoint still fundamentally renders from request sample_data/column_overrides, which is acceptable for template preview/designer use but not as the primary live reviewed-document export path.
hard_decisions_from_codex: Use a proper document_line_items table in the database for this pass. Do not hide production line items only inside a JSON blob unless you need a temporary mirror for compatibility.

Use Review Scan as the primary human confirmation/edit surface for line items, because that is where the user still thinks in terms of extracted document content. Review Mapping may show a compact read-only summary or handoff cue, but line-item editing should not live only there.
ProductMaster matching is best-effort only in this task: suggest matches and mark low-confidence rows for review, but do not block the workflow on perfect matching or dedupe.

Keep W5-12 as one implementation task and one commit/tag family: real-data export path plus line-item extraction/review/export. You may phase the code internally, but do not split this prompt into separate pseudo-completions.

human_findings_to_close.symptom: enable_stock=true companies still only show an honest banner; no real line-item rows are extracted, persisted, reviewed, or exported.
Export still depends on demo/static/runtime sample rows instead of a backend-built dataset from reviewed documents.
Customer-critical line-item companies cannot yet produce confirmable/exportable scanned line rows on the live product path.

implementation_scope: 1. Add persistent storage for extracted document line items.
2. Branch the processing path by company.settings.enable_stock: false stays header-only, true adds a non-blocking line-item extraction sub-stage after header extraction.
3. Reuse the TASK-906 PoC extractor logic where practical instead of inventing a second line-item extraction approach.
4. Persist extracted line items with confidence/status fields and enough structure for review + export.
5. Add Review Scan line-item review/edit/confirm behavior for documents that have extracted rows.
6. Build a backend-driven live export dataset path from real reviewed/mapped documents; sample_data remains allowed only for preview/designer workflows.
7. Include confirmed line-item rows in export output for enable_stock=true companies when such rows exist.

data_model_expectation.behavior_rule: Header extraction must still complete even if line-item extraction fails. A line-item failure should mark the line-item sub-stage/error honestly, not kill the whole document if header extraction already succeeded.

review_surface_expectation: Review Scan should show extracted line-item rows below or alongside header extraction for documents that have line items.
Rows should be editable enough for MVP confirmation: product_name, qty, unit, unit_price, line_amount, line_type, optional match/notes.
There must be an explicit confirm/review status per line or per document-line-item set so export can exclude unconfirmed rows if needed.
If you add a compact Review Mapping summary, keep it secondary; do not move the main edit workflow away from Review Scan in this task.
export_path_expectation: Do not let live export continue to rely primarily on caller-supplied sample_data for real document output.
Introduce a backend-built dataset path using company/document context from real reviewed/mapped documents.
Template preview can still use sample_data/column_overrides; live export should prefer real rows when the caller selects reviewed documents/company context.
When enable_stock=true and confirmed line items exist, export must include line-level rows built from those persisted line items.
When enable_stock=false, export must continue to work for header-only companies without line-item blocking.
hard_requirements: Do not remove the existing honest banner for enable_stock=true until the real line-item path is truly working; replace or narrow the banner only when the backend behavior changes accordingly.
Do not fake line-item success from placeholder/demo/sample rows.
Do not regress the existing W5-02 Processing tracker or W5-03 user fixes.
If you extend Processing stages, integrate line-item progress into the existing stage tracker rather than creating a disconnected second status model.
Use apply_patch edits only; keep changes scoped to the real W5-12 path.
Add focused backend/unit/e2e tests that prove the new live-data behavior.
Commit and push finished work to origin/dev with tracking tag W5-EXPORT-LINEITEM-REALDATA-04 in the completion report.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed/mapped document can be exported through a backend-built dataset path without relying on caller-provided sample_data as the primary live source.
For enable_stock=true companies, processing produces persisted line-item rows on supported documents.
Header-only companies still process/export normally with no line-item requirement.
Review Scan exposes line-item rows for human confirmation/edit instead of only showing a banner.
Confirmed line-item rows can flow into export output.
Focused tests cover persistence, status branching, review/update behavior, and export output shape.
verification_expectation: Run focused pytest coverage for any new model/workflow/export logic.
Run focused Playwright coverage for the line-item/review/export path where practical.
If local static-server E2E is used, remember the /static/auth.js requirement already documented in the W5 processing tests.
final_instruction_to_claude: Finish the real W5-12 path. Do not stop at a review or a plan, and do not return only a banner refinement. The task is only complete when reviewed-document export no longer depends on demo/runtime sample rows and enable_stock=true companies can produce persisted, confirmable, exportable line-item rows on the real product path.
